verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers Databricks' data platform, governance, agent, and dev-tool features but contains no mention of any control to opt out of, or prevent, customer data being used to train Databricks' (or third-party) AI models — no data-use policy, model-training opt-out setting, or contractual guarantee is cited. missing for 10: an explicit AI-training opt-out/data-use policy, documentation of contractual or technical controls preventing model training on customer data, and any independent confirmation of such a guarantee.
